faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BHU Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the BHU Research Assistant post is August 18, 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in a relevant subject or any Social Science discipline with at least 55% marks, along with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D. from a UGC-recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST, PwD, and women candidates as per ICSSR norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the BHU Research Assistant job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the BHU Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant position at BHU?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant post will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this BHU recruitment?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position at Banaras Hindu University is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Banaras Hindu University located?
faq.answer: Banaras Hindu University is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply through online mode for this BHU recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this BHU Research Assistant recruitment is strictly offline. Online applications will not be accepted.
